A very good English speaking dentist in Phuket Town!

I don't know how to explain it, but I'm incredibly impressed with the service at this clinic. I was impressed from the front-of-house service to the atmosphere in the treatment room. The doctor and all the staff are lovely, attentive, and provide excellent advice and consultations. Anyone considering orthodontic treatment here is guaranteed to be extremely impressed. Five stars isn't enough; I'd give them all! 🥰🥰🥰

I recently had the pleasure of visiting this new dental clinic in Phuket, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth, and the modern, comfortable, and impeccably clean interior immediately put me at ease.

The dentist, who also happens to be the owner, was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain every step of the teeth whitening procedure to me, as it was my first time. Before starting, he recommended a thorough teeth cleaning for optimal results, which turned out to be the most gentle and thorough cleaning I've ever experienced.

For someone who's usually apprehensive about dental visits, I can confidently say that this clinic is perfect for anyone with dental anxiety. Throughout the whitening procedure, the staff stayed by my side, constantly checking on my comfort level. When I experienced discomfort in my neck, they promptly offered a pillow for support.

Moreover, when the treatment became too uncomfortable for me, the dentist acted swiftly to end it, ensuring my well-being was the top priority. Although I experienced some discomfort (commonly referred to as zingers) for a day following the treatment, I found that doing it in the evening after a substantial meal helped, and by the next day, I felt much better.

The results were remarkable, and all my friends noticed the difference in my teeth – a testament to the clinic's expertise and care. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone seeking professional dental care in Phuket. It's rare to find such a combination of modern facilities, skilled professionals, and genuine concern for patients' comfort and well-being.
